regions.full_page: Thanks - Maurice Gauthier - 8 - of Belle River Ontario. Kicked by a horse Tuesday last week July 11 - seemed unconscious with fractured skull till Saturday when aunt phoned requesting enroll- ment and prayers. Next morning surprised every one asking for weniers - perfectly rational; is coming.fine. Deo Gr.
